svg.title: One-to-One Consent Readiness Funnel
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-one-to-one-consent-readiness-funnel; chapter number: 6; chart type: funnel; title: One-to-One Consent Readiness Funnel; subtitle: Where lead-gen operators stood before January 27 enforcement; caption: Most operators were still testing consent capture, and Eric Troutman read only two of ten circulating one-to-one forms as passing.; assumptions note: The first, second, third and fifth stages are percentage shares from the ActiveProspect and boberdoo webinar poll taken 111 days before January 27 enforcement. The fourth stage expresses Troutman's 'probably only 2 of 10' as a share. Agent CRM and Revenx report the rule vacated, so regulatory direction is contested among practitioners.; note: Sources: ActiveProspect, Inc. (uXTg2yB_ZTM), Eric Troutman via Seasalt AI (KBFaRW7QmVQ), TechMarketer (B9lfPgUUls0), Calldrive (jHMaZ1k0rpY).; stages: label: Operators testing consent capture; value: 50; display: 50%; conversion: Largest bloc in the ActiveProspect and boberdoo poll; detail: Single select for each item, no select all, and no pre-check (TechMarketer).; label: Operators with an idea only; value: 22; display: 22%; conversion: Planning stage, no live forms yet; detail: Bid per company, not per whole lead; with 15 buyers the form shows 15 checkboxes (ActiveProspect, Inc.).; label: Operators fully ready; value: 20; display: 20%; conversion: Consent records producible by buyer and seller; detail: Calldrive pairs a consent token with IP address and a video of the form fill.; label: Circulating forms that pass review; value: 20; display: 2 of 10 forms; conversion: Probably only 2 of 10 pass (Troutman); detail: Lead sellers create the risk, but buyers bear it, with indemnity flowing back.; label: Operators not yet started; value: 7; display: 7%; conversion: Exposed to per-call fines; detail: Quoted exposure runs $500 to $2,000 per text or call violation (Amy Chan via Seasalt AI).

rect.title: label: Operators testing consent capture; value: 50; display: 50%; conversion: Largest bloc in the ActiveProspect and boberdoo poll; detail: Single select for each item, no select all, and no pre-check (TechMarketer).

label: Operators with an idea only; value: 22; display: 22%; conversion: Planning stage, no live forms yet; detail: Bid per company, not per whole lead; with 15 buyers the form shows 15 checkboxes (ActiveProspect, Inc.).

label: Operators fully ready; value: 20; display: 20%; conversion: Consent records producible by buyer and seller; detail: Calldrive pairs a consent token with IP address and a video of the form fill.

label: Circulating forms that pass review; value: 20; display: 2 of 10 forms; conversion: Probably only 2 of 10 pass (Troutman); detail: Lead sellers create the risk, but buyers bear it, with indemnity flowing back.
label: Operators not yet started; value: 7; display: 7%; conversion: Exposed to per-call fines; detail: Quoted exposure runs $500 to $2,000 per text or call violation (Amy Chan via Seasalt AI).

text.title: Assumptions: The first, second, third and fifth stages are percentage shares from the ActiveProspect and boberdoo webinar poll taken 111 days before January 27 enforcement. The fourth stage expresses Troutman's 'probably only 2 of 10' as a share. Agent CRM and Revenx report the rule vacated, so regulatory direction is contested among practitioners.
